title: Calibrate and Evaluate a Smoothed Int8 Layer
summary: Measure calibration channels, transform a linear layer, simulate int8 arithmetic and inspect validation regressions.

stages.title: Measure the calibration distribution
stages.description: Keep activation and weight channel axes explicit; zero channels remain visible.

stages.title: Move channel range without changing the linear function
stages.description: Divide activation channels and multiply matching weight rows using positive scales.

stages.title: Quantize and localize output error
stages.description: Simulate a declared int8 recipe and compare per-token failures to an unquantized reference.

stages.title: Compose calibration and validation
stages.description: Sweep supplied smoothing exponents, retain all-candidate MSE selection, and report the independent release gate.
